\i0 \cf0 \
- This dataset contains anatomical brain MRI scans of tumor and non-tumor patients.\
- Images were preprocessed and resized to 320x320 pixels.\
- Labels: tumor (50 cases), non_tumor (40 cases).\
- Original data collected from Asia International Hospital and Hiwa Hospital from Sulaymaniyah, Kurdistan Region, Iraq\
- Dataset Link: https://openneuro.org/datasets/ds006318/versions/1.0.0}

metadata.studyDesign: This study collected multi-sequence MRI scans from patients with brain tumors, covering modalities such as T1W, T2W, Flair, T1W contrast, ADC, and DWI. The images were converted into volumetric NIfTI format to preserve spatial resolution and support AI-based analysis. Additional augmented versions with Gaussian noise and transformations are included to enable machine learning robustness studies.
metadata.studyDomain: Neuroimaging, Brain Tumor Analysis, Medical Imaging, Artificial Intelligence
